text: Install, list, preview remove RStudio themes included rstudiothemes. functions adapted selected rsthemes functions. MIT License Copyright © rsthemes authors. Important: functions work RStudio return NULL called IDEs. exception list_rstudiothemes(list_installed = FALSE).

title: Manage RStudio themes — rstudiothemes-actions
code: install_rstudiothemes(   style = c("all", "dark", "light"),   themes = NULL,   destdir = NULL )  remove_rstudiothemes(style = c("all", "dark", "light"))  list_rstudiothemes(style = c("all", "dark", "light"), list_installed = TRUE)  try_rstudiothemes(style = c("all", "dark", "light"), themes = NULL, delay = 0)

title: Manage RStudio themes — rstudiothemes-actions
text: style Theme group: "", "dark" "light". themes Optional character vector theme names. provided, themes used style ignored. destdir Optional directory .rstheme files. default, themes installed rstudioapi::addTheme(). Use argument copy themes non-standard directory instead. list_installed TRUE (default), list installed rstudiothemes themes. FALSE, list themes available package. delay Number seconds wait themes. Set 0 prompted continue theme.

title: Manage RStudio themes — rstudiothemes-actions
text: install_rstudiothemes() remove_rstudiothemes() return NULL invisibly. list_rstudiothemes() returns character vector theme names. try_rstudiothemes() side effects. cycles bundled themes, lets preview one restores original theme quit.

title: Manage RStudio themes — rstudiothemes-actions
text: install_rstudiothemes() installs bundled themes. remove_rstudiothemes() removes bundled themes. list_rstudiothemes() lists installed available themes. try_rstudiothemes() previews bundled themes.
